en.text: [...]lei(?) beside / contrary to the abundant things. But such things will be examined in this way(?) often: whether, when the more abundant thing is present, nature more gladly departs / is released from this(?), and again(?) [...]
en.review_status: Unreviewed model draft; not a scholarly reading. Underdots denote uncertain readings, kept as (?) in translation without restoration. The opening lei has uncertain lambda and is left as a fragmentary ending. pollakis has an uncertain lambda. hotan has an uncertain initial. toutou is marked throughout as uncertain. palin has uncertain ending and is followed by illegible traces rendered as [...] and not translated. Curly brackets in houto{i} mark an editorially added iota, rendered as in this way(?) without choosing between forms. No editorial question-mark character occurs in the passage; interrogative force comes only from the word poteron. Beginning and end are broken off and are not supplied.
